samples_reviewed.question_text: What fraction does \(\frac{1}{8}\) equal parts represent?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The lc is 'Read and write similar fractions in fraction notation', but samples 44 and 45 are 'Write 596 in words' and 'Write 456 in words' -- whole-number-to-words conversions with no similar-fraction pair and no fraction notation at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: As with mat_g2_na_q4_1, the number_reading DNA's 2 registered combos supply content that has nothing to do with fraction notation, so a chunk of this node's coverage is off-topic by construction rather than by sampling bad luck.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Writing 'five hundred ninety-six' from 596 is a 3-digit place-value word-naming task, cognitively unrelated to writing a fraction like 1/8 in notation, so the node mixes two different skill demands under one competency label.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The number_reading axis contributes variants that cannot serve 'similar fractions' at all, so the registered variant space for this node includes combos structurally incapable of testing the stated lc.

competency_alignment.rationale: Three-digit number-to-words items belong to a numeration strand, not to fraction reading and writing, so part of the sampled content sits entirely outside -- not just beyond -- the exact wording of this competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: 456 and 596 have no defined relationship to the denominator set {2,3,4,5,6,8} this fraction node is scoped to, so there is no coherent 'scale' to judge for that half of the sampled items.
